title: Revenue per order status
statementMd:
Total value of order lines per order status, rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `status`, `value`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT o.status, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.status;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
